primaryChecks.text: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir;
contextRefs: JOS 13:25 — Their border was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, to Aroer that is near Rabbah;
